_comment: Editor layout for the MaxEnt diffusion-time FCS model (MaxEntFCSModel). The entropy weight decides the answer here, so the L-curve is part of the editor rather than a separate plot tab: the sweep controls, the corner and click-to-adopt all live in the shared `lcurve` section, which retired this model's bespoke plot class and its controller.

sections.label: Prior
sections.description: Entropy prior: what the recovered distribution is pulled toward where the data say nothing. 'uniform' is flat ignorance (the historical behaviour); 'lognormal' centres the prior on the diffusion-time grid at prior_c with a width of prior_w decades -- the inversion then reports the data's deviations from that expectation rather than from flatness.
reg is log10 of the entropy weight. td_min/td_max/n_td set the log-spaced diffusion-time grid the distribution is recovered on; s is the structure parameter and b the baseline.

sections.title: L-curve
sections.description: Regularization sweep: the corner is the weight that balances misfit against the smoothness of the recovered distribution.
Press sweep to sample the weight over the range shown, then click a point (or 'corner') to adopt its weight.
